Color chains and conjugation

Browse all notebooks · Quark annihilation into gluons Build SU(3) color generators using Spenso's existing tensor constructors. Contracted fundamental indices can be collected into compact chains or traces. Conjugation gives the same result before and after this collection. For Hermitian generators, conjugating ||((T^a T^b)_{ij}||) gives ||((T^b T^a)_{ji}||). The order and endpoints both reverse. The trace of three generators can be complex, so its order must also reverse under conjugation. These rules belong to shared Idenso algebra and also apply through dirac_adjoint when a larger expression contains fermion chains.
